sources.entry: BentoPDF ⚠ - Powerful, privacy-first, client-side PDF toolkit that allows you to manipulate, edit, merge, and process PDF files directly in your browser. (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Nodejs/Docker

summary.one_liner: BentoPDF is a self-hostable, client-side PDF toolkit that lets you edit, merge, convert and process PDFs in the browser without uploading files to a server.
summary.what_it_does: BentoPDF provides a large set of PDF tools that run entirely in the user's browser, so files are not sent to a server. The README lists tools for organizing pages (merge, split, reorder, rotate, N-up, booklet printing, attachments), editing (annotation/PDF editor, text editing, fillable forms, watermarks, page numbers, bookmarks, redaction, flatten), and converting to PDF from many formats (images, Word/Excel/PowerPoint, OpenDocument, e-books, email, Visio) and from PDF to images, text, JSON, CSV, Excel and CBZ. It also covers securing and optimizing (compress, repair, encrypt/decrypt, permissions, signing, digital signatures with X.509 certificates, OCR, metadata removal, sanitize, linearize). It can be self-hosted as static files or via Docker images, with options for branding, disabling specific tools, and air-gapped deployment with WASM modules hosted internally. It is dual-licensed: AGPL-3.0 free, or a paid commercial license.
use_cases: merge or split PDF files in the browser
edit and annotate PDFs without uploading them
convert Office documents and images to PDF privately
run a self-hosted team PDF tool
OCR scanned PDFs into searchable documents
sign PDFs or apply digital signatures
how_to_run: npx http-server -c-1 (serve an extracted dist-{version}.zip from GitHub releases)
git clone the repo, then npm install && npm run build && npm run preview
docker-compose up -d (using the bentopdf-simple image in a compose file)
stack: WebAssembly (LibreOffice WASM, PyMuPDF, Ghostscript, CoherentPDF, Tesseract OCR)
Cloudflare Workers (CORS proxy for digital signatures)
notable: Client-side processing: files stay in the browser, no server-side PDF processing required
Self-Hosted 'simple' build includes all PDF tools without marketing pages
Disable individual tools or PDF editor features via build args or a runtime config.json
Air-gapped deployment script and manual steps for offline WASM and OCR assets
Over 50 tools listed, including a visual workflow builder
caveats: Advanced features (PyMuPDF, Ghostscript, CoherentPDF) are AGPL-3.0 components loaded from jsDelivr CDN by default; offline use requires self-hosting those WASM files
Office conversion requires SharedArrayBuffer, so the app needs cross-origin isolation and a secure context (HTTPS for LAN IPs)
Digital Signature tool requires deploying a CORS proxy (Cloudflare Workers) for some certificates; the Commercial license costs $79 for closed-source use
